_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored) and edit. install.sh reads this.
_claude_in_opencode: OPT-IN, BAN RISK. Reuses your Claude subscription OAuth token inside opencode via the opencode-claude-auth plugin. Anthropic's ToS restricts subscription tokens to official clients and has enforced with account bans since Jan 2026. false = leave Claude to Claude Code only (recommended for shared/team use).
